PARAMS = {
    "W_in":     (20.0, 6.0, 60.0),     # input pair width [um]
    "L_in":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "W_p":      (14.0, 4.0, 40.0),     # PMOS mirror width [um]
    "L_p":      (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "W_tail":   (25.0, 8.0, 80.0),     # tail width [um]
    "L_tail":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "itail":    (60e-6, 30e-6, 66e-6), # tail current (mirror ratio = itail/iref)
    "R1":       (1.0e6, 2.0e5, 3.0e6),
    "cf_ratio": (2.5, 1.0, 6.0),       # Cf / Cin
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd, vcm = 1.8, 0.9
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 0.5e-12)

    # ---- current budget (keep 5% margin on 140 uW) ----
    itail = min(p["itail"], 0.95 * 140e-6 / vdd - iref)
    i1 = itail / 2.0
    ratio = itail / iref

    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
        for _ in range(48):
            m = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, m, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
                lo = m
            else:
                hi = m
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    Win, Lin, Wp, Lp = p["W_in"], p["L_in"], p["W_p"], p["L_p"]
    Wt, Lt = p["W_tail"], p["L_tail"]

    # PMOS diode node
    vsg_p = solve_vgs("p", Wp, Lp, i1, 0.8)
    vsg_p = solve_vgs("p", Wp, Lp, i1, vsg_p)
    vd1 = vdd - vsg_p

    # input pair source node (body effect included)
    vs = 0.35
    for _ in range(6):
        vgs_in = solve_vgs("n", Win, Lin, i1, max(vd1 - vs, 0.05), vs)
        vs = vcm - vgs_in
    opn = lut.op("n", Win, Lin, vgs_in, vcm - vs, vs)
    opp = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_p, vdd - vcm)
    gm = opn["gm"]
    gds_out = opn["gds"] + opp["gds"]
    cin = opn["cgg"] + 10e-15

    # tail mirror (ref diode sized by ratio, same L)
    Wref = max(0.42, Wt / ratio)
    vgs_t = solve_vgs("n", Wref, Lt, iref, 0.8)
    vgs_t = solve_vgs("n", Wref, Lt, iref, vgs_t)

    # ---- feedback network, calibrated for finite gain ----
    R1 = p["R1"]
    g1t, g2t = 0.15709, 0.01797
    Rf, R2 = g1t * R1, g1t * R1 / g2t
    for _ in range(8):
        Gl = 1.0 / (Rf + 1.0 / (1.0 / R1 + 1.0 / R2))
        A = gm / (gds_out + Gl)
        beta = (1 / Rf) / (1 / Rf + 1 / R1 + 1 / R2)
        corr = A * beta / (1 + A * beta)
        Rf = g1t * R1 / corr
        R2 = Rf * corr / g2t
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * corr
    a2 = -(Rf / R2) * corr

    Cf = p["cf_ratio"] * cin
    tau = Rf * Cf
    C1, C2 = tau / R1, tau / R2
    csum = C1 + C2 + cin
    beta_hf = Cf / (Cf + csum)
    cout = cl + Cf * csum / (Cf + csum) + 25e-15
    bw = gm * beta_hf / (2 * PI * cout)

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wref, Lt)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, Lt)
    n.M("M1", "d1", "vcm", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, Lin)      # non-inverting input
    n.M("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, Lin)   # inverting input
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("RI1", "vin1", "vinn", R1)
    n.R("RI2", "vin2", "vinn", R2)
    n.R("RF", "vinn", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CI1", "vin1", "vinn", C1)
    n.C("CI2", "vin2", "vinn", C2)
    n.C("CF", "vinn", "vout", Cf)

    sys_off = (opp["gds"] * abs(vcm - vd1) / gm) / beta
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": a2, "bw": bw,
               "vout_offset": sys_off,
               "power": vdd * (iref + itail)}
